svg.title: Phase 5 complete Google Sheet training import flow
svg.desc: The import branch begins when Add workout is chosen on the current week, then covers app-owned Google Sheet selection, one-week scope confirmation, bounded extraction, human review, conflict and failure handling, and final Apply to the active program.

g.text: TRAINING · COMPLETE GOOGLE SHEET IMPORT FLOW
Import is an Add workout branch inside the active program. Only the reviewed source week is applied to the current app week.
Selecting source Week 5 creates no drafts, provenance, placeholders, or comparisons for source Weeks 1–4 or 6 onward.
Google Sheets only · sorted by recently modified
No range extracted · no Week 5 workout row
Excluded: Warming Up · Macro Check In
Execution values were removed before extraction
No other week is queued or read in the background.
You can safely leave and return to this import.
7 movements · 1 value differs from stored Week 5
All exercise matches and types still need review
Both the app and sheet changed
A returned value did not match its cited cell.
Full Body 1 remains a draft. No program rows exist yet.
No other week was read or retried.
Review rows 69–87, then retry only Full Body 2.
Exclude only this workout from the Week 5 import.
Only the reviewed prescriptions were applied.
10 · DESKTOP REVIEW · SAME TWO-STEP CONTRACT, MORE COMPARISON SPACE
No Week 5 row will be created
No extraction · no comparison · no rows
Values remain verbatim. Every exercise identity and execution type must be confirmed before Apply.
1 conflict and 2 unconfirmed execution types remain
Apply stays unavailable until every visible decision is resolved.
Addresses let the member verify placement. Execution cells are not shown because their values were never extracted.
Changing an extracted value turns it into an explicit member edit; Apply records that reviewed result atomically.
The import changes workouts in M1 only. Program creation and activation are outside this flow.
Add workout is available only on the current week.
Both paths add workouts to Week 5. Neither creates a program.
